AccessControlEntry.title: AccessControlEntry
AccessControlEntry.description: Remote complimentary tester/owner access grant or account suspension record managed exclusively by the app owner.

emailLower.description: Normalized lowercase Google account email address (immutable after creation).

status.description: ALLOWED grants complimentary tester/owner Pro access; BLOCKED immediately suspends app access.

note.description: Optional owner note or reason shown when relevant (max 140 chars).

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner admin who created or last updated this record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

/access_controls/{entryId}.description: Access control overrides keyed by deterministic SHA-256 hex digest of normalized lowercase email.
